insight: Co-founded by Snehal Antani, the first CTO of U.S. Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC) and a former Splunk CTO.
name: Horizon3.ai
tagline: Autonomous pentesting that safely runs real attacks in production to find exploitable risk.
description: Horizon3.ai's NodeZero platform runs autonomous, production-safe penetration tests that chain real attacker techniques — credential abuse, misconfigurations, and exploitable CVEs — across internal, external, cloud, and hybrid environments without deploying agents. It shows exactly how an attacker could move and what they would reach, prioritizes fixes by impact, and re-tests to verify remediation. It is sold to enterprises and government as continuous attack-surface validation rather than a once-a-year manual engagement.
edge: Agentless, production-safe pentests you can run continuously and on demand — replacing periodic manual engagements with always-on attack validation.
pros: No agents to deploy in your environment
Runs continuously, not once a year
cons: Aimed at orgs with security teams
